=== METHODOLOGICAL RULE, IN THIRTEEN PARTS -- APPLY ALL OF THEM ===
(i) Ask the fetch for the ENTIRE ROW / TABLE / PASSAGE / FILE VERBATIM with an explicit instruction to write 'ABSENT' or 'CANNOT READ' rather than infer; never accept a summarised 'the value is/isn't X'. (ii) String-search the EXACT stored quotations AND the exact stored NUMBERS. (iii) ALSO PULL THE VERBATIM DEFINITION OF THE METRIC, not only its value -- this single check produced ctr-0002, ctr-0003, ctr-0004, ctr-0006, half of ctr-0007, ctr-0008 and ctr-0009. (iv) PULL THE WHOLE TABLE, not the rows the claim needs. (v) A PRESENT verdict may be trusted from one fetch; an ABSENT verdict MUST be confirmed against a second URL form -- checking FOUR things first: the ABSTRACT, a DIFFERENT URL RENDERING, THAT YOU FETCHED THE FILE THE CLAIM ACTUALLY CITES, and THAT THE VERSION YOU FETCHED CONTAINS THE MATERIAL AT ALL. (vi) A SOURCE CAN BE CLEAN WHILE THE STATE'S ACCOUNT OF IT IS NOT -- and the CONVERSE also holds, so READ THE STATE BEFORE RE-DERIVING ANYTHING FROM A LOG. (vii) CHECK HEDGES IN BOTH DIRECTIONS -- a hedge is a claim and must be scoped as precisely as an assertion. (viii) STRING-MATCHING A CLAIM'S QUOTATIONS AND NUMBERS DOES NOT TEST ITS QUANTIFIER OR ITS SCOPE. (ix) VERIFYING A VALUE DOES NOT VERIFY WHAT THE VALUE MEASURES, AND A SUMMARISED 'PRESENT' IS AS UNTRUSTWORTHY AS A BARE 'ABSENT'; ASK WHETHER THE SAME METRIC NAME IS DEFINED MORE THAN ONCE. (x) WHEN A FILE IS LARGE, GET ITS BYTE SIZE FROM THE HOSTING API BEFORE RECORDING ANY ABSENCE -- for HuggingFace the tree API with recursive=true returns a COMPLETE listing with sizes and is far better than the rendered page. (xi) 'WHICH TEXT EXECUTES' IS NOT A PRESENT VERDICT; where a docstring and a live code branch describe different rules, BOTH are present and string matching settles nothing -- ask explicitly whether a branch is live code or sits inside a triple-quoted string, comment or docstring. (xii) A DERIVED NUMBER MUST BE AUDITED AGAINST THE LOG THAT DERIVED IT, NOT AGAINST THE STATE THAT CITES IT. A mis-scoped derivation is invisible to every other check this project runs -- not a quotation so string-matching cannot catch it, not a source claim so no G2 re-fetch can reach it, and the number itself is correct so recomputation confirms it. UNAUDITED DERIVED QUANTITIES STILL IN THIS BASE: src-0001's four derived ECE means, src-0002's five derived plausible-but-not-correct percentage points, src-0006's derived ranges, cycle 18's src-0006 crossover means, and the four normalisation figures on extraction-vs-reasoning-ordinal-axis's route 2.
